loops.minute_1: Enter Tartarus, meet Charon (skeleton practice dummy), first room enemies (Shades/Grunts), learn dodge-roll and attack rhythm. Immediate feedback: movement and damage register instantly.
loops.minute_10: Clear 3–4 rooms, encounter decision nodes (reward type: Nectar, weapon unlock, stat boost). Enter mid-tier area (Asphodel passage). Mirror of Night upgrades feel tangible (last run's Darkness invested).
loops.hour_5: Traverse Asphodel, Elysium, or Stygian depths depending on weapon choice. Encounter Elite boss (deposits weapon aspect or relic). Weapon synergies and Mirror bonuses form coherent run identity. Combat is now *reactive* (dodge patterns, use powered-up abilities).
loops.endgame: Confront Hades (Act IV, ~4th boss). Defeat = escape to surface (victory). Upon escape, Zagreus withers on surface and is forced to return to House of Hades (narrative loop). Repeat until 10 escapes to unlock true ending. New dialogue/relationship advancement unlock across runs.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat Hades and escape the Underworld to the surface (repeatable 10x for true ending)
objectives.defeat_condition: Zagreus health reaches zero (return to House of Hades with progress reset, except permanent upgrades)
objectives.player_goal: Escape the Underworld repeatedly; unlock new weapons and Mirror upgrades; deepen relationships with NPCs; discover narrative secrets across dozens of runs

games.retention_answer: Death is progress—every failed run unlocks dialogue, relationship advancement, and story beats. Permanent Mirror upgrades ensure each run feels stronger than the last. Six weapons × three+ aspects each creates gameplay novelty. Narrative gates (escape count, NPC relationship thresholds) create long-form engagement hooks. Why return: 'What story unlock do I get this run? Can I beat this with a different weapon build?'

loops.minute_1: Spawn in Basement, top-down movement (WASD/arrows), tears fire at enemies in aimed direction. First room of 1–3 enemies (Gaper, Pacer). Pick up coins/bombs/hearts dropped by enemies. Learn dodge patterns (move away from enemy fire).
loops.minute_10: Clear 5–8 rooms, item pickups accumulating (2–5 items collected). Tear modifiers begin to synergize (Brimstone replaces tears with laser, Dr. Fetus swaps tears for bombs). Active items recharge mid-run (bomb spawners, temporary shields). Emerging build identity ('laser run', 'bomb run', 'tears run').
loops.hour_5: Deep in Depths/Womb, 20–30 items collected, synergies fully active. Combat is *reactive* (screen-clearing damage, occasional one-shots, minimal dodging needed). Item pool quality escalates (gold items, rare synergies). Approaching boss gauntlet (Monstro, Chub, Mom's Heart, etc.).
loops.endgame: Defeat boss at floor's end (Mom in Basement → Mom's Heart in Womb → Satan in Sheol or Isaac in Cathedral → Lamb in Dark Room → Blue Baby in Chest → ??? → Mega Satan → Hush → Delirium). Each boss defeat unlocks new items, characters, alternate pathways, and deeper floors. Loop: try → fail/succeed → unlock new content → grow item pool → discover new synergies → repeat.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat one of multiple final bosses (Mom's Heart, Satan, Isaac, Lamb, Blue Baby, Mega Satan, Hush, Delirium depending on progression). Each defeat unlocks new content.
objectives.defeat_condition: Isaac's health reaches zero (run ends, progress reset except unlock state)
objectives.player_goal: Defeat bosses to unlock new items, characters, floors, and alternative pathways; discover item synergies; collect all unlockables; speedrun or play for high-score runs

games.retention_answer: Unlockable content gates progression depth: beating Mom's Heart 11 times unlocks Sheol; beating Isaac unlocks Cathedral; etc. Procedural generation ensures no two runs identical. Item synergy discovery is self-driven—players experimentally find broken combos ('breaking the game'), creating emergent satisfaction. 600+ items × synergy interactions = infinite novelty. Why return: 'What new item/character/floor unlocked? Can I break this game with a new synergy?'

loops.minute_1: Face Neow (optional starting bonus: relic, gold, cards, or card upgrade). First hallway combat: draw 5 cards from deck (Strike/Defend), gain 3 energy per turn. Decide which cards to play to minimize damage taken. End of combat: choose 1 card from 3 options to add to deck (or skip). Gain ~20 gold.
loops.minute_10: Complete 2–3 hallway fights, build early deck identity (scaling? blocking? card draw?). First elite encounter appears on map (risk/reward: +45 gold + relic vs. health loss). Node map structure becomes clear (hallway → shop → elite → rest site). Early relics begin to shape strategy.
loops.hour_5: Act 2 transition. Deck synergies fully wired (enabler + payoff cards = multiplicative damage or defense). Relics are now synergizing with card choices (extra energy relic + high-cost cards = powerful turns). Scaling concerns emerge ('Will my deck survive Act 3?'). Elite relics available; rarity escalates.
loops.endgame: Act 3 boss chosen (path varies; player has agency). Defeat final boss → escape (victory). For true ending, must collect 3 keys (red/green/blue) before Act 3 boss, then ascend to Act 4, defeat Heart (750+ HP, scaling enemy strength per turn). Ascension levels (A0–A20+) add enemy HP and debuffs, extending mastery progression.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat Act 3 boss (escape the Spire). True victory: collect 3 keys, reach Act 4, defeat the Heart (750+ HP, scaling strength)
objectives.defeat_condition: Deck becomes unviable before defeating final boss (cannot generate enough damage or block; health reaches zero)
objectives.player_goal: Build a synergistic deck from card offerings; acquire relics that multiply card effects; survive 45+ encounters; optimize synergies per run; master Ascension difficulty tiers

games.retention_answer: Every run is a puzzle: 'Given this relic + these card options, what is the optimal deck?' Dozens of relics × hundreds of card combos × 4 characters = infinite unique runs. Ascension difficulty (A0–A20+) gates mastery progression separately from each run's success. Card discovery moments (finding a synergy that 'just works') create intrinsic motivation. Why return: 'What new synergy can I find? Can I beat Ascension X with this character? Can I speedrun or no-relic run?'
